limit_usd.description: LimitUSD is the per-period cap as a decimal string (e.g. "10.000000000").

period.description: Period is the calendar bucket: "day", "month", or "year".

precedence.description:
Precedence is the group's 1-based charge order; lower is charged first and
the minimum is 1 (0 is reserved for users). Maps to the domain Budget's
ordinal after server-side re-sequencing.
